events.what: Drone attacks shut Saudi East-West pipeline (7 million b/d capacity); Yanbu loadings suspended Sept. 12, resumed Sept. 23
Panama-flagged crude tanker On Peace struck 9 nm off Oman and set on fire, 12 of 19 crew injured; five tankers struck Oct. 3-6
Russian Aframax tanker Aframax Rio (Urals to India) set ablaze, fire out Oct. 7; two civilian vessels hit in Bulgarian waters, one sank, two seafarers killed
BBC reports Saudi-backed Yemeni forces say they retook Bab al-Mandab coastline as far north as Mocha; Houthis dispute
G7 leaders commit to release 100 million barrels via IEA; members agree to refrain from energy export restrictions
IEA backs faster release of March-agreed stocks and prioritized diesel release; governing board meets again next week
Trump says no US diesel export ban, after G7 agreement; earlier backed idea Sept. 22
Trump executive order temporarily lifts restrictions on dyed diesel use
Trump signs law allowing tariffs up to 100% on top five importers of Russian crude or gas and sanctions on tankers evading sanctions
Tropical Storm Isaias shuts in 25.08% of GoM crude output; Chevron shuts four facilities, Shell Mars, Olympus, Ursa, Vito, Appomattox; hurricane forecast Oct. 8
Libya NOC issues third force majeure warning since August; Zawiya pipeline and gates shut by armed groups
Vitol's 100,000 b/d Fujairah refinery back up after temporary shutdown
Korea Customs Service seeks FTA preferential tariffs for US crude shipped via Panama pipeline
ING says market nervousness persists until progress on US-Iran deal; SEB says endgame prediction harder, questions over US Hormuz operation

themes.theme: Hormuz and Gulf shipping attacks vs recovering flows
themes.summary: Hormuz transits fell to 19 on Oct. 6 amid tanker attacks while Saudi East-West pipeline is back at 5.8 million b/d and Iraq Sept exports rose to 2.960 million b/d.

themes.theme: Emergency stock releases and diesel tightness
themes.summary: IEA backed faster release of the 100 million barrels G7 committed, prioritizing diesel; crude fell Oct. 7 and USGC-Europe diesel arbitrage narrowed.

themes.theme: US inventory draw and export surge
themes.summary: EIA showed commercial crude down 3.19 million barrels to 424.13 million with exports up 33% to 4.77 million b/d and SPR at a 44-year low.
Record Aframax freight pushed WTI Midland premiums higher while Hungo hit a record -$19.60/b and Middle East sour differentials hit five-week lows.

themes.theme: Tropical Storm Isaias in Gulf of Mexico
themes.summary: 25.08% of GoM crude output shut in while about 2.5 million b/d of eastern USGC refining capacity is at risk as Isaias nears hurricane strength.

themes.theme: Outlooks: higher near term, surplus ahead
themes.summary: EIA raised Q4 Brent to $105/b, while IEA sees balances moving to oversupply by Q1 2027 and World Bank sees Gulf exports normalizing by mid-2027.

themes.theme: Russia exports, Black Sea attacks and sanctions
themes.summary: Russian seaborne crude exports rose to 4.09 million b/d in September, a tanker was set ablaze in the Black Sea, and new US sanctions authority adds compliance risk.
Shell indicative refining margin rose to $42/b in Q3 and Repsol reported a record $36.20/b, with diesel cracks at records supporting crude demand.
